entries.03a7e8944660bf3c: This service receives commissions from pharmaceutical companies and develops and operates PHR platforms for patients and healthcare professionals for each disease, in the areas of lifestyle-related diseases, cancer, and specified chronic diseases. The company receives platform construction fees (development costs) and usage fees from pharmaceutical companies. Use as an information-gathering tool (ePRO) for clinical research is also increasing. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥337 million.
entries.06aeb117a1df898f: This is a business that provides PHR (Personal Health Record) platform services that support patients in self-management in the treatment of various diseases, including lifestyle-related diseases such as diabetes and hypertension. The reportable segment consists solely of this business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥635 million. As of December 31, 2025, the number of consolidated employees was 44.

entries.3d5976751bb36331: It is a cloud service built and operated in-house by the company's group, supporting patients in the self-management of lifestyle-related diseases in general, such as diabetes and hypertension.
